what_happens: A household files the application in person, by mail, online or as the state allows; a filing needs only name, address and a signature, and the office must take it the same day the household asks
source_words: an application "containing the applicant’s name and address, which is signed by either a responsible member of the household or the household’s authorized representative"

what_happens: An eligibility worker interviews the household at first certification and at least once every 12 months; states may hold it by phone
source_words: households "must have a face-to-face interview with an eligibility worker at initial certification and at least once every 12 months thereafter", except as (e)(2) provides

what_happens: The state lists what it must verify; the household gets at least 10 days to provide it
source_words: "The State agency must give households at least 10 days to provide required verification."

what_happens: An eligible household gets the chance to receive benefits, or a denial notice, within 30 days of filing
source_words: "no later than 30 calendar days following the date the application was filed"

what_happens: A household with very little income or cash gets benefits on its EBT card within 7 days of filing
source_words: benefits available "not later than the seventh calendar day following the date an application was filed"
